scope: Step 4D: selected road signs and linked variants; not an exhaustive examination list.
disclaimer: This material is a learning aid to help understanding. It is not an official source and cannot replace current official information or applicable rules.
language_policy: Official Swedish names are preserved from Transportstyrelsen. All English labels, explanations and alternative text are original editorial wording, not official translations.
accessibility_policy: Alt text identifies the sign and the exact usable artwork; read it with its teaching caption. Still images do not reproduce flashing, sound or movement. Retain text equivalents in the PDF and check reading order in step 6. Held artwork has no approved alt text and must not be placed.
source_policy: Official Transportstyrelsen detail pages and primary Swedish legislation only. Variant pages with no explanation inherit the parent meaning except M19a and M20a, which have their own meanings. Practical reminders are editorial teaching advice.
